about.title: Our story
about.intro: Every piece we offer begins as a branch of an olive tree in and around Bethlehem.
about.p1: Olive trees here can live for hundreds of years. The wood our carvers use comes from branches trimmed when the trees are pruned.
about.p2: Each piece is cut, carved, sanded and finished by hand, so the grain, colour and size vary a little from one piece to the next.
about.p3: We are a small shop, and we would rather tell you plainly what you are buying than promise too much. If you have a question about a piece, write to us on WhatsApp and we will answer honestly.
about.sister: Gethsemane is the sister store of <link>holylandtimber.com</link>.
about.emblemAlt: Gethsemane logo: an ancient olive tree and olive press inside an arch, topped by a cross
about.name: The name Gethsemane comes from Hebrew and Aramaic words commonly translated as “oil press”. It refers to the olive garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem, where, according to the Gospels, Jesus prayed on the night before his crucifixion. Our pieces are carved from olive wood, and the name keeps that link to the olive tree.

howToOrder.title: How to order
howToOrder.intro: There is no online checkout. Every order is confirmed by a person, on WhatsApp, before you pay anything.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Short answers to the questions we hear most. Something missing? Ask us on WhatsApp.
faq.a1: They are handmade by carvers in Bethlehem. Each piece is cut, carved and finished by hand.
faq.q2: Will my piece look exactly like the photo?
faq.a2: Not exactly. Olive wood has a natural grain, so colour and pattern vary from piece to piece. That variation is part of the material, not a defect.
faq.q3: Where does the wood come from?
faq.a3: From branches trimmed when olive trees are pruned.
faq.q4: Can a piece be engraved or customised?
faq.a4: Some pieces can be engraved. Ask us on WhatsApp before you order; engraved and personalised pieces cannot be returned unless faulty.
faq.q5: Do you supply churches, ministries or shops?
faq.a5: Yes. Write to us on WhatsApp or through the contact page with the pieces and quantities you need, and we will reply with a quote.
faq.q6: How do I place an order?
faq.a6: Add pieces to your order and send it to us on WhatsApp. We confirm availability, the shipping cost and the final total, then send payment instructions. Nothing is charged on this website.
faq.q7: Where do orders ship from, and how long does delivery take?
faq.a7: {shipFrom} We prepare orders in {processingMin}–{processingMax} business days; delivery typically takes {deliveryMin}–{deliveryMax} business days after dispatch to most destinations, and remote areas can take longer. These are estimates, not guarantees.
faq.a8: Customs duties, import taxes and any handling fees are paid by the buyer. In some countries taxes are instead collected by the carrier or at the border. We describe the contents and value truthfully on customs forms.
faq.a9: Yes, within {days} days of delivery. We ask that the piece is unused and in its original packaging, and that you contact us first with your order reference. Engraved or personalised pieces (unless faulty) and pieces marked as final sale cannot be returned this way. These limits do not apply to your statutory right of withdrawal (EU/UK) or your legal guarantees; exceptions to withdrawal apply only to personalised or custom-made items.
faq.q10: What if my parcel arrives damaged?
faq.a10: Tell us within {days} days of delivery and send photos of the outer box and the item. We will replace it or refund you, and you will not need to send it back. This does not affect your legal rights.
faq.a11Instructions: After we confirm your order on WhatsApp, we send you payment instructions. We ship once payment is received. There is no payment on this website.

returns.title: Returns and refunds
returns.intro: If a piece is not right for you, you can return it.
returns.period: If you change your mind, you can return a piece within {days} days of delivery. To make this simple for both of us, we ask that the piece is unused and in its original packaging, that you include your order reference, and that you contact us before sending it back.
returns.excluded1: Engraved or personalised pieces, except where faulty (we tell you before you order).
returns.excluded2: Pieces clearly marked as final sale before you order.
returns.variation: Natural variation in grain and colour is a quality of olive wood, not a defect, and does not affect your statutory rights.
returns.cost: Return shipping is paid by the customer unless we made a mistake or the piece is faulty. Please note that international return postage can cost more than the piece itself; we are happy to talk it through with you first.
returns.refundEu: Customers in the EU and the UK: we refund you to the original payment method within 14 days of receiving your withdrawal notice. We may wait until we have received the piece back, or proof that you have sent it.
returns.refundOther: Other customers: we refund to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after we receive and inspect the return.
returns.refundShipping: If you withdraw under the statutory right below, we also refund the standard outbound delivery cost. Otherwise the original shipping cost is not refundable, unless we made a mistake.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page describes what this website actually does with information. It is short because the site collects very little.
privacy.noAccounts: There are no customer accounts. The site uses no analytics, no advertising or tracking cookies, and loads no third-party scripts.
privacy.browser: Your order, wishlist and any details you type on the order page (name, country, notes, gift note) are stored only in your own browser (local storage). They are not sent to us.
privacy.whatsappTitle: When you send an order or a message
privacy.whatsapp: Information reaches us only when you choose to send a WhatsApp message{email, select, none {} other { or an email}}. The message contains what you see before sending it. WhatsApp (Meta) processes it under its own privacy policy. To deliver an order we share your name, address and phone number with the shipping carrier.
privacy.use: We use your details only to answer you and to fulfil your order. We do not sell or share personal data for marketing.
privacy.retentionYears: We keep order records for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}, then delete them.
privacy.retentionDefault: We keep order details only as long as needed to fulfil your order and meet legal obligations such as accounting.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold about you, and you can complain to your data protection authority. Contact us through the <link>contact page</link>.
privacy.transfer: We are based in Bethlehem. When you write to us from another country, your information is transferred to us there; when we ship your order, it goes from Bethlehem to the carriers that deliver your parcel. The website itself is hosted in the United States (see Hosting).
privacy.children: This site is not aimed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16.
privacy.security: This site is served over HTTPS. It does not take payments and does not store your details on our servers.
privacy.changes: If what the site does changes (for example, if we add analytics), we will update this page first.
privacy.hosting: This site is hosted by Vercel Inc. in the United States. Like any web host, Vercel processes technical data such as IP addresses to deliver pages and keep the site secure, so this data is transferred to the United States.
privacy.controller: The controller responsible for your personal data is:
privacy.cookies: The site uses two preference cookies: NEXT_LOCALE (your language) is set on your first visit, and currency (your currency) when you choose one. Both last one year and are sent to our server with every request, so that pages appear in your language and currency. They are not used for tracking.
privacy.basisContract: Performing your order: answering your request, confirming, shipping and handling returns.
privacy.basisInterest: Our legitimate interest in running the site and keeping it secure.
privacy.basisConsent: Your consent for anything optional, such as a gift note or the details you choose to type on the order page. You can withdraw it at any time.

accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility
accessibilityPage.intro: We want everyone to be able to browse and order from this site.
accessibilityPage.target: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA. Pages are tested with automated checks, with a keyboard only and at screen widths from 320 pixels up.
accessibilityPage.done: Text and controls meet AA contrast, every control can be reached with a keyboard and shows a visible focus ring, buttons are at least 44 pixels tall, motion is reduced when you ask your device for it, and changes to your order are announced to screen readers.
accessibilityPage.gap1: Product photos are still placeholders; descriptions of the real pieces will follow.
accessibilityPage.gap2: Messages are sent through WhatsApp, whose own accessibility we do not control.
accessibilityPage.gap3: We have not yet tested the site with disabled users in person.
accessibilityPage.feedback: If something does not work for you, please tell us through the <link>contact page</link> and we will do our best to fix it.

care.title: Caring for olive wood
care.intro: Olive wood is dense and lasts a long time with very little care.
care.daily: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
care.oil: If the wood looks dry, rub in a few drops of food-safe mineral oil or a wood-bowl oil, leave it for a few minutes and wipe off the rest. Once or twice a year is usually enough. Avoid cooking oils such as olive oil, which can go rancid.
care.kitchen: Wash quickly by hand with a little mild soap and dry straight away.
care.avoid3: Radiators, heaters and long hours of strong sun.
care.variation: Small changes in colour over time are natural and part of the wood’s character.
